lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Dust settles on the velvet drapes
I trace the ghosts of hallways cold
Tracing all the long-lost shapes
Of memories that never grow old
[chorus]
Oh, in this Mansion's Shadow I remain
Waiting for the laughter in the hall
Dancing through the window pane
Answering a long-forgotten call
[verse]
The moonlight carves the floorboard lines
I hear their steps upon the stair
But time decays the ancient signs
And leaves me only with the air
[chorus]
Oh, in this Mansion's Shadow I remain
Waiting for the laughter in the hall
Dancing through the window pane
Answering a long-forgotten call
[bridge]
The tea is cold upon the tray
The portrait frame is cracked and thin
They promised they would come to stay
Before the winter set us in
[chorus]
Oh, in this Mansion's Shadow I remain
Waiting for the laughter in the hall
[outro]
